main.welcome:
Welcome

Paste the address of a IIIF manifest at the top of the window, then click Show.
Digital libraries often point to it with the IIIF logo or a “Manifest” link.

You can also open a manifest saved on your computer,
or drag a link or a file into this window.

help.text:
How to use

  1. Open a document: paste the address of the IIIF manifest in the bar at the top and click Show (or open a file, or drag a link into the window).
  2. Browse: the document's metadata are on the right, Document tab; click a thumbnail to see the image's own (Image tab). Double-click or Enter: view the image larger.
  3. Choose images: a click ticks or unticks a thumbnail. For a run of images, click the first one, then Shift+click (or Ctrl+Shift+click) the last one. Buttons and the Selection menu: select all, select none, invert.
  4. Download: Download… button at the bottom right. Choose the folder and how file names are built (a prefix such as the shelfmark, sequence number, folio…); the preview shows the resulting names.

An interrupted download can be resumed: images already present are kept.
